name: avalet
description: Meeting assistant for systems analysts: listens to the call, suggests what to ask, keeps the transcript. Local-first, bring your own LLM.
author: Elshad Astanov

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.cjs tcp:5174 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron .
scripts.build: rimraf dist-electron dist && npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:main
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: npm run build:native && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs -c.mac.identity=null --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:dir: npm run build:native && npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs -c.mac.identity=null --mac dir --publish never
scripts.build:tests: rimraf dist-electron dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.e2e:xvfb: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1600x1200x24" playwright test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:i18n && npm test
